item_short_desc: Rothco's MOLLE Tactical Tech Bag combines the traditional elements of our classic canvas Tech Bag with a tactical twist; we've added Molle Loops on the outside of the front flap. The interior of the tech bag is padded which makes it ideal for an iPad or tablet.
